metadata.title: Funding and Infrastructure Action Plan
metadata.preparedFor: CFNEIA, Black Hawk County Public Health, Advancing Together Core Team, and partner organizations
metadata.shortPurpose: Map funding needs, align funder conversations, support partner proposals, and sustain coalition infrastructure.
metadata.purpose: This charter-style action plan guides CFNEIA, Black Hawk County Public Health, the Advancing Together Core Team, and partner organizations in implementing Economic Stability Strategies 3 and 5. It turns the funding worksheet into a quarterly work plan for aligning partners, mapping needs, engaging funders, responding to emerging issues, and sustaining coalition infrastructure for residents most affected by economic barriers.
metadata.coalitionRole: Advancing Together helps align partner needs, funding opportunities, rapid-response decisions, and infrastructure conversations without replacing partner-led fundraising.

sections.title: Funding Landscape and Governance
sections.summary: Confirm roles, decision authority, current investments, gaps, and first-year funding needs.

actions.title: Convene the Strategy 3 and 5 funding action team and confirm the combined charter.
keyTasks: Schedule quarterly meetings
confirm that Strategies 3 and 5 will be managed as one funding and infrastructure strategy
document lead, core team, and collaborator roles
identify decisions needed by the end of Q2
successIndicators: Team charter, meeting rhythm, lead roles, and first-year decision list are documented
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026.

actions.title: Collect all Economic Stability action plans and create a first funding-needs inventory.
keyTasks: Ask each action planning team what needs funding, who would implement it, whether the need is one-time, pilot, or ongoing, and whether it supports staffing, program delivery, infrastructure, communications, evaluation, incentives, transportation, or community compensation
successIndicators: Inventory includes year 1 and 2026-2028 funding needs for each Economic Stability strategy
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026.

actions.title: Document current pilots, investments, and local funding examples that already support CHIP priorities.
keyTasks: Capture early examples such as the LSI pilot, House of Hope, banks, One City United, One Cedar Valley, immigrant/refugee resource navigation work, and related nonprofit investments
note what is funded, by whom, and what gaps remain
resources: local funder and business relationship information
successIndicators: A draft funding landscape map summarizes current investments, early examples, gaps, and opportunities without duplicating partner fundraising work
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026 - Q2: Oct-Dec 2026.

actions.title: Clarify decision authority for Advancing Together funding alignment, fiscal sponsorship, and use of the coalition name.
keyTasks: Define who can authorize Advancing Together support for applications, when CFNEIA or another partner could serve as fiscal sponsor, how decisions are documented, and what needs broader coalition or funder input
resources: fiscal sponsorship and grant management guidance
legal or finance review if needed
successIndicators: Decision authority memo identifies approval paths, documentation expectations, and issues needing additional review
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026.

sections.title: Shared Funding Process and Funder Engagement
sections.summary: Build practical tools for coordinated funding decisions, funder-facing communication, and local engagement.

actions.title: Develop a funding opportunity decision tree for partner-led, coalition-supported, and rapid-response requests.
keyTasks: Create shared questions for funding opportunities, including fit with CHIP strategies, implementer readiness, funding type, sustainability, evaluation needs, partner impact, and whether Advancing Together should endorse, co-develop, support, or stay out
successIndicators: Draft decision tree is ready for partner testing and includes a short timeline for opportunity review
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026 - Q3: Jan-Mar 2027.

actions.title: Create a funder-facing overview of Economic Stability strategies, gaps, partners, and investment opportunities.
keyTasks: Translate the funding landscape and CHIP strategies into a clear story for local, state, and national funders
show how investments can support coordination, programs, staffing, evaluation, communications, and people not currently reached
successIndicators: A concise overview is approved for use in funder conversations and partner proposal support
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026 - Q3: Jan-Mar 2027.

actions.title: Engage Metro Funders and selected local employers before making specific funding requests.
responsibleParties: local employers such as Veridian and health system partners
keyTasks: Share the draft landscape map and overview
ask what information funders need
discuss lessons from COVID-response funding
identify where aligned funding or employer investment may be realistic
successIndicators: At least one structured funder conversation occurs and priority information needs are documented
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027.

actions.title: Design simple criteria and review steps for rapid-response or micro-grant support.
keyTasks: Define eligible uses such as micro-grants, community events, emergency needs, capacity-building, policy recommendations, or small pilots
set a short decision timeline, reporting expectations, and safeguards so the process does not pull support away from core work
successIndicators: Rapid-response draft criteria, review process, and minimum flexible-funding estimate are ready for pilot consideration
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027 - Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

actions.title: Finalize the shared funding process toolkit for use by strategy teams and proposal partners.
keyTasks: Package the funding-needs inventory, decision tree, funder overview, rapid-response criteria, and proposal support expectations
orient strategy teams to when and how to use the tools
successIndicators: Toolkit is available to partners and at least three strategy teams use it to clarify funding needs or opportunities
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

sections.title: Rapid Response and Opportunity Response
sections.summary: Test rapid-response support, scan outside opportunities, and strengthen partner-led proposals.

actions.title: Test the rapid-response or micro-grant process with a limited first round if flexible funds are available.
responsibleParties: Metro Funders or aligned local funders
keyTasks: Select a small number of emerging needs or pilot ideas
use the draft criteria and short review timeline
prioritize requests tied to CHIP strategies, areas with higher burden, and partners with fewer administrative resources
successIndicators: First-round requests are reviewed and funded or deferred with clear reasons and lessons for process improvement
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q4: Apr-Jun 2027 - Q5: Jul-Sep 2027.

actions.title: Maintain a state, regional, and national funding opportunity scan tied to Economic Stability strategies.
keyTasks: Track opportunities related to economic stability, immigrant/refugee resource navigation, workforce, housing, transportation, community infrastructure, and coalition backbone support
note deadlines, fit, match requirements, and likely applicants
resources: partner expertise on eligibility and match
successIndicators: Opportunity tracker is reviewed quarterly and at least four viable outside opportunities are assessed by Q7
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q4: Apr-Jun 2027 - Q7: Jan-Mar 2028.

actions.title: Provide proposal-readiness support for smaller or community-led organizations connected to priority strategies.
keyTasks: Offer light technical assistance on budgets, outcomes, fiscal sponsorship options, data needs, and partner roles
connect organizations with larger applicants when that strengthens reach without sidelining community trust
successIndicators: At least three smaller or community-led organizations receive readiness support or are included in aligned proposal development
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027 - Q6: Oct-Dec 2027.

actions.title: Support aligned partner proposals that bring new dollars into the community for CHIP-related work.
keyTasks: Use the decision tree to decide whether Advancing Together will provide letters, data, coordination support, partner alignment, or fiscal sponsorship
avoid unnecessary competition for existing local funds
document what the coalition contributed
successIndicators: At least two partner proposals are supported, aligned, or strengthened through the shared process by Q8
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027 - Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

actions.title: Track outcomes and lessons from funded pilots, rapid-response requests, and proposal support.
keyTasks: Collect basic information on reach, funding used, barriers addressed, people not currently reached, implementation lessons, and whether the activity should continue, scale, adapt, or stop
successIndicators: Pilot and proposal-support lessons are summarized and used to refine criteria, funder messaging, and 2028 priorities
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q6: Oct-Dec 2027 - Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

sections.title: Sustainability, Evaluation, and Reporting
sections.summary: Sustain funding coordination, evaluate pilots, and report progress through Advancing Together routines.

actions.title: Update the funding landscape map and identify braided, blended, or pooled funding options for backbone support.
keyTasks: Review current investments and gaps
identify whether coordination, communications, evaluation, convening, and partner alignment can be funded through braided sources, pooled local funds, outside grants, or employer investment
successIndicators: Sustainability memo identifies realistic funding mechanisms for coalition infrastructure and Economic Stability implementation
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q7: Jan-Mar 2028 - Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

actions.title: Refine community-informed input for funding priorities and rapid-response decisions.
keyTasks: Connect with lived experience strategy partners to determine practical ways for residents affected by economic barriers to inform priority setting, review criteria, or pilot design without creating unnecessary burden
resources: community compensation or stipends if available
successIndicators: Funding process includes a practical method for community-informed input on priorities or pilot design
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

actions.title: Report quarterly funding coordination progress to Advancing Together and funder partners.
keyTasks: Share updates on funding needs, opportunities reviewed, proposals supported, rapid-response requests, new dollars pursued or secured, funded pilots, lessons learned, and barriers needing coalition attention
successIndicators: Quarterly reports are shared and used to guide coalition decisions, funder conversations, and partner follow-up
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q7: Jan-Mar 2028 - Q10: Oct-Dec 2028.

actions.title: Complete the 2028 review and sustainability plan for Economic Stability funding coordination.
keyTasks: Review what was built, which tools were used, what funding was pursued or secured, how smaller organizations participated, which pilots showed promise, and what ownership, staffing, fiscal, and evaluation supports are needed beyond 2028
successIndicators: Final review names owners, funding needs, refresh schedule, and next-step decisions for sustaining the process beyond December 2028
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Funding and Infrastructure source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q10: Oct-Dec 2028.
